company.name: Malga
company.shortDescription: Malga develops payments as a service platform that provides access to multiple connections through one integration.
company.description: Malga is an API to accept payments with multiple payment providers. Malga  gives digital businesses access to multiple payments services through a single integration, and the ability to change between them on a transaction-to-transaction basis without writing code.
company.headquarters: Rio De Janeiro, Rio de Janeiro, Brazil

productsAndServices.description: A modular platform that enables businesses to build and customize their payment systems with minimal coding, integrating multiple payment providers and methods through a single interface.
productsAndServices.name: Intelligent Payment Infrastructure

productsAndServices.description: A service that manages and optimizes payment transactions by routing them intelligently across multiple providers to increase approval rates and reduce failures.
productsAndServices.name: Payment Orchestration and Intelligent Flows

productsAndServices.description: A set of security features including real-time fraud detection, card tokenization, 3DS agnostic support, and compliance with PCI DSS to protect payment flows.
productsAndServices.name: Fraud Protection Suite

productsAndServices.description: A centralized dashboard providing real-time data, transaction reports, and sales performance metrics for payment management.
productsAndServices.name: Unified Payment Dashboard and Reporting

productsAndServices.description: Checkout tools including transparent checkout, plugins, SDKs, and payment links that can be tailored to match the business's branding and customer experience needs.
productsAndServices.name: Customizable Checkout Solutions

productsAndServices.description: A payment management feature that enables flexible transaction splitting among multiple partners, vendors, or business units with customizable rules.
productsAndServices.name: Split-Agnostic Payment Management

insights.title: Funding is concentrated in the latest major round
insights.statement: The latest disclosed Series A round raised $5,574,913, or 66.37% of reported total funding.

insights.title: Valuation increased across disclosed rounds
insights.statement: Known post-money valuation rose from $3,512,384 to $36,600,963, a 10.42x increase.
insights.implication: The disclosed financing history indicates a material valuation step-up between the earliest and latest rounds with known valuations.
caveats: Only rounds with a disclosed post-money valuation are compared.
